14 /-!
15 # The symmetric square
16 
17 This file defines the symmetric square, which is `α × α` modulo
18 swapping.  This is also known as the type of unordered pairs.
19 
20 More generally, the symmetric square is the second symmetric power
21 (see `Data.Sym.Basic`). The equivalence is `Sym2.equivSym`.
22 
23 From the point of view that an unordered pair is equivalent to a
24 multiset of cardinality two (see `Sym2.equivMultiset`), there is a
25 `Mem` instance `Sym2.Mem`, which is a `Prop`-valued membership
26 test.  Given `h : a ∈ z` for `z : Sym2 α`, then `Mem.other h` is the other
27 element of the pair, defined using `Classical.choice`.  If `α` has
28 decidable equality, then `h.other'` computably gives the other element.
29 
30 The universal property of `Sym2` is provided as `Sym2.lift`, which
31 states that functions from `Sym2 α` are equivalent to symmetric
32 two-argument functions from `α`.
33 
34 Recall that an undirected graph (allowing self loops, but no multiple
35 edges) is equivalent to a symmetric relation on the vertex type `α`.
36 Given a symmetric relation on `α`, the corresponding edge set is
37 constructed by `Sym2.fromRel` which is a special case of `Sym2.lift`.
38 
39 ## Notation
40 
41 The element `Sym2.mk (a, b)` can be written as `s(a, b)` for short.
42 
43 ## Tags
44 
45 symmetric square, unordered pairs, symmetric powers
46 -/
47

61 /-- This is the relation capturing the notion of pairs equivalent up to permutations. -/
62 @[aesop (rule_sets := [Sym2]) [safe [constructors, cases], norm]]
63 inductive Rel (α : Type u) : α × α → α × α → Prop
64   | refl (x y : α) : Rel _ (x, y) (x, y)
65   | swap (x y : α) : Rel _ (x, y) (y, x)
66 
67 attribute [refl] Rel.refl
68 
69 @[symm]
70 theorem Rel.symm {x y : α × α} : Rel α x y → Rel α y x := by aesop (rule_sets := [Sym2])
71 
72 @[trans]
73 theorem Rel.trans {x y z : α × α} (a : Rel α x y) (b : Rel α y z) : Rel α x z := by
74   aesop (rule_sets := [Sym2])
75 
76 theorem Rel.is_equivalence : Equivalence (Rel α) :=
77   { refl := fun (x, y) ↦ Rel.refl x y, symm := Rel.symm, trans := Rel.trans }
78 
79 /-- One can use `attribute [local instance] Sym2.Rel.setoid` to temporarily
80 make `Quotient` functionality work for `α × α`. -/
81 @[instance_reducible]
82 def Rel.setoid (α : Type u) : Setoid (α × α) :=
83   ⟨Rel α, Rel.is_equivalence⟩
84 
85 @[simp, grind =]
86 theorem rel_iff' {p q : α × α} : Rel α p q ↔ p = q ∨ p = q.swap := by
87   aesop (rule_sets := [Sym2])
88 
89 theorem rel_iff {x y z w : α} : Rel α (x, y) (z, w) ↔ x = z ∧ y = w ∨ x = w ∧ y = z := by
90   simp
91 
92 end Sym2
93 
94 /-- `Sym2 α` is the symmetric square of `α`, which, in other words, is the
95 type of unordered pairs.
96 
97 It is equivalent in a natural way to multisets of cardinality 2 (see
98 `Sym2.equivMultiset`).
99 -/
100 abbrev Sym2 (α : Type u) := Quot (Sym2.Rel α)
101 
102 /-- Constructor for `Sym2`. This is the quotient map `α × α → Sym2 α`. -/
103 protected abbrev Sym2.mk {α : Type*} (a b : α) : Sym2 α := Quot.mk (Sym2.Rel α) (a, b)
104 
105 /-- `s(x, y)` is an unordered pair,
106 which is to say a pair modulo the action of the symmetric group.
107 
108 It is equal to `Sym2.mk (x, y)`. -/
109 notation3 "s(" x ", " y ")" => Sym2.mk x y
110

138 /-- Dependent recursion principle for `Sym2`. See `Quot.rec`. -/
139 @[elab_as_elim]
140 protected def rec {motive : Sym2 α → Sort*}
141     (f : (a b : α) → motive s(a, b))
142     (h : (a b c d : α) → (h : Rel α (a, b) (c, d)) → Eq.ndrec (f a b) (Sym2.sound h) = f c d)
143     (z : Sym2 α) : motive z :=
144   Quot.rec (fun (a, b) ↦ f a b) (fun (a, b) (c, d) ↦ h a b c d) z

146 /-- Dependent recursion principle for `Sym2`. See `Quot.recOn`. -/
147 @[elab_as_elim]
148 protected def recOn {motive : Sym2 α → Sort*} (z : Sym2 α)
149     (f : (a b : α) → motive s(a, b))
150     (h : (a b c d : α) → (h : Rel α (a, b) (c, d)) → Eq.ndrec (f a b) (Sym2.sound h) = f c d) :
151     motive z :=
152   Quot.recOn z (fun (a, b) ↦ f a b) (fun (a, b) (c, d) ↦ h a b c d)

154 /-- A dependent recursion principle for `Sym2` that uses heterogeneous equality. -/
155 @[elab_as_elim]
156 protected def hrec {motive : Sym2 α → Sort*}
157     (f : (a b : α) → motive s(a, b))
158     (h : (a b : α) → f a b ≍ f b a)
159     (z : Sym2 α) : motive z :=
160   Quot.hrecOn _ (fun (a, b) ↦ f a b) <| by
161     simp only [rel_iff']
162     rintro _ _ (rfl | rfl)
163     exacts [HEq.rfl, h _ _]

199 /-- The universal property of `Sym2`; symmetric functions of two arguments are equivalent to
200 functions from `Sym2`. Note that when `β` is `Prop`, it can sometimes be more convenient to use
201 `Sym2.fromRel` instead. -/
202 def lift : { f : α → α → β // ∀ a₁ a₂, f a₁ a₂ = f a₂ a₁ } ≃ (Sym2 α → β) where
203   toFun f :=
204     Quot.lift (uncurry ↑f) <| by
205       rintro _ _ ⟨⟩
206       exacts [rfl, f.prop _ _]
207   invFun F := ⟨fun a b ↦ F s(a, b), fun _ _ => congr_arg F eq_swap⟩
208   right_inv _ := funext <| Sym2.ind fun _ _ => rfl
209 
210 @[simp]
211 theorem lift_mk (f : { f : α → α → β // ∀ a₁ a₂, f a₁ a₂ = f a₂ a₁ }) (a b : α) :
212     lift f s(a, b) = (f : α → α → β) a b :=
213   rfl
214 
215 @[simp]
216 theorem coe_lift_symm_apply (F : Sym2 α → β) (a₁ a₂ : α) :
217     (lift.symm F : α → α → β) a₁ a₂ = F s(a₁, a₂) :=
218   rfl
219 
220 /-- A two-argument version of `Sym2.lift`. -/
221 def lift₂ :
222     { f : α → α → β → β → γ //
223         ∀ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂, f a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ = f a₂ a₁ b₁ b₂ ∧ f a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ = f a₁ a₂ b₂ b₁ } ≃
224       (Sym2 α → Sym2 β → γ) where
225   toFun f :=
226     Quotient.lift₂ (s₁ := Sym2.Rel.setoid α) (s₂ := Sym2.Rel.setoid β)
227       (fun (a : α × α) (b : β × β) => f.1 a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2)
228       (by
229         rintro _ _ _ _ ⟨⟩ ⟨⟩
230         exacts [rfl, (f.2 _ _ _ _).2, (f.2 _ _ _ _).1, (f.2 _ _ _ _).1.trans (f.2 _ _ _ _).2])
231   invFun F :=
232     ⟨fun a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ => F s(a₁, a₂) s(b₁, b₂), fun a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ => by
233       constructor
234       exacts [congr_arg₂ F eq_swap rfl, congr_arg₂ F rfl eq_swap]⟩
235   right_inv _ := funext₂ fun a b => Sym2.inductionOn₂ a b fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
236 
237 @[simp]
238 theorem lift₂_mk
239     (f :
240     { f : α → α → β → β → γ //
241       ∀ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂, f a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ = f a₂ a₁ b₁ b₂ ∧ f a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ = f a₁ a₂ b₂ b₁ })
242     (a₁ a₂ : α) (b₁ b₂ : β) : lift₂ f s(a₁, a₂) s(b₁, b₂) = (f : α → α → β → β → γ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ :=
243   rfl
244 
245 @[simp]
246 theorem coe_lift₂_symm_apply (F : Sym2 α → Sym2 β → γ) (a₁ a₂ : α) (b₁ b₂ : β) :
247     (lift₂.symm F : α → α → β → β → γ) a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ = F s(a₁, a₂) s(b₁, b₂) :=
248   rfl

281   toFun b := s(a, b)
282   inj' b₁ b₁ h := by
283     simp only [Sym2.eq, Sym2.rel_iff', Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, Prod.swap_prod_mk] at h
284     obtain rfl | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h <;> rfl

292 lemma lift_comp_map {g : γ → α} (f : {f : α → α → β // ∀ a₁ a₂, f a₁ a₂ = f a₂ a₁}) :
293     lift f ∘ map g = lift ⟨fun (c₁ c₂ : γ) => f.val (g c₁) (g c₂), fun _ _ => f.prop _ _⟩ :=
294   lift.symm_apply_eq.mp rfl

296 lemma lift_map_apply {g : γ → α} (f : {f : α → α → β // ∀ a₁ a₂, f a₁ a₂ = f a₂ a₁}) (p : Sym2 γ) :
297     lift f (map g p) = lift ⟨fun (c₁ c₂ : γ) => f.val (g c₁) (g c₂), fun _ _ => f.prop _ _⟩ p := by
298   conv_rhs => rw [← lift_comp_map, comp_apply]

305 /-- This is a predicate that determines whether a given term is a member of a term of the
306 symmetric square.  From this point of view, the symmetric square is the subtype of
307 cardinality-two multisets on `α`.
308 -/
309 protected def Mem (x : α) (z : Sym2 α) : Prop :=
310   ∃ y : α, z = s(x, y)
311 
312 @[aesop norm (rule_sets := [Sym2])]
313 theorem mem_iff' {a b c : α} : Sym2.Mem a s(b, c) ↔ a = b ∨ a = c :=
314   { mp := by
315       rintro ⟨_, h⟩
316       rw [eq_iff] at h
317       aesop
318     mpr := by
319       rintro (rfl | rfl)
320       · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
321       rw [eq_swap]
322       exact ⟨_, rfl⟩ }
323 
324 instance : SetLike (Sym2 α) α where
325   coe z := { x | z.Mem x }
326   coe_injective' z z' h := by
327     simp only [Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h
328     obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := z
329     obtain ⟨x', y'⟩ := z'
330     have hx := h x; have hy := h y; have hx' := h x'; have hy' := h y'
331     simp only [mem_iff'] at hx hy hx' hy'
332     aesop
333 
334 instance : PartialOrder (Sym2 α) := .ofSetLike (Sym2 α) α
335 
336 @[simp]
337 theorem mem_iff_mem {x : α} {z : Sym2 α} : Sym2.Mem x z ↔ x ∈ z :=
338   Iff.rfl
339 
340 theorem mem_iff_exists {x : α} {z : Sym2 α} : x ∈ z ↔ ∃ y : α, z = s(x, y) :=
341   Iff.rfl

343 @[ext]
344 theorem ext {p q : Sym2 α} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ p ↔ x ∈ q) : p = q :=

347 theorem mem_mk_left (x y : α) : x ∈ s(x, y) :=
348   ⟨y, rfl⟩
349 
350 theorem mem_mk_right (x y : α) : y ∈ s(x, y) :=
351   eq_swap ▸ mem_mk_left y x
352 
353 @[simp, aesop norm (rule_sets := [Sym2]), grind =]
354 theorem mem_iff {a b c : α} : a ∈ s(b, c) ↔ a = b ∨ a = c :=

356 
357 theorem out_fst_mem (e : Sym2 α) : e.out.1 ∈ e :=
358   ⟨e.out.2, by rw [Sym2.mk, e.out_eq]⟩
359

361   ⟨e.out.1, by rw [eq_swap, Sym2.mk, e.out_eq]⟩
362 
363 theorem ball {p : α → Prop} {a b : α} : (∀ c ∈ s(a, b), p c) ↔ p a ∧ p b := by
364   simp
365 
366 @[simp] lemma coe_mk {x y : α} : (s(x, y) : Set α) = {x, y} := by ext z; simp
367 
368 theorem coe_map (f : α → β) (z : Sym2 α) : z.map f = f '' z := by
369   cases z
370   simp [Set.image_pair]

372 /-- Given an element of the unordered pair, give the other element using `Classical.choose`.
373 See also `Mem.other'` for the computable version.
374 -/
375 noncomputable def Mem.other {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : α :=
376   Classical.choose h
377 
378 @[simp]
379 theorem other_spec {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : s(a, Mem.other h) = z :=
380   (Classical.choose_spec h).symm
381 
382 theorem other_mem {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : Mem.other h ∈ z := by
383   convert mem_mk_right a <| Mem.other h
384   rw [other_spec h]
385 
386 theorem mem_and_mem_iff {x y : α} {z : Sym2 α} (hne : x ≠ y) : x ∈ z ∧ y ∈ z ↔ z = s(x, y) := by
387   constructor
388   · cases z
389     rw [mem_iff, mem_iff]
390     aesop
391   · rintro rfl
392     simp
393 
394 theorem eq_of_ne_mem {x y : α} {z z' : Sym2 α} (h : x ≠ y) (h1 : x ∈ z) (h2 : y ∈ z) (h3 : x ∈ z')
395     (h4 : y ∈ z') : z = z' :=
396   ((mem_and_mem_iff h).mp ⟨h1, h2⟩).trans ((mem_and_mem_iff h).mp ⟨h3, h4⟩).symm
397 
398 instance Mem.decidable [DecidableEq α] (x : α) (z : Sym2 α) : Decidable (x ∈ z) :=
399   z.recOnSubsingleton fun _ _ => decidable_of_iff' _ mem_iff
400

406   aesop

409 theorem map_congr {f g : α → β} {s : Sym2 α} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = g x) : map f s = map g s := by
410   ext y
411   simp only [mem_map]
412   constructor <;>
413     · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
414       exact ⟨w, hw, by simp [hw, h]⟩

416 /-- Note: `Sym2.map_id` will not simplify `Sym2.map id z` due to `Sym2.map_congr`. -/
417 @[simp]
418 theorem map_id' : (map fun x : α => x) = id :=
419   map_id

421 /--
422 Partial map. If `f : ∀ a, p a → β` is a partial function defined on `a : α` satisfying `p`,
423 then `pmap f s h` is essentially the same as `map f s` but is defined only when all members of `s`
424 satisfy `p`, using the proof to apply `f`.
425 -/
426 def pmap {P : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (s : Sym2 α) : (∀ a ∈ s, P a) → Sym2 β :=
427   let g (p : α × α) (H : ∀ a ∈ Sym2.mk p.1 p.2, P a) : Sym2 β :=
428     s(f p.1 (H p.1 <| mem_mk_left _ _), f p.2 (H p.2 <| mem_mk_right _ _))
429   Quot.recOn s g fun p q hpq => funext fun Hq => by
430     rw [rel_iff'] at hpq
431     have Hp : ∀ a ∈ s(p.1, p.2), P a := fun a hmem =>
432       Hq a (Sym2.mk_eq_mk_iff.2 hpq ▸ hmem : a ∈ s(q.1, q.2))
433     have h : ∀ {s₂ e H}, Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s => (∀ a ∈ s, P a) → Sym2 β) (g p) (b := s₂) e H =
434       g p Hp := by
435       rintro s₂ rfl _
436       rfl
437     refine h.trans (Quot.sound ?_)
438     rw [rel_iff', Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.swap_prod_mk]
439     apply hpq.imp <;> rintro rfl <;> simp
440 
441 theorem forall_mem_pair {P : α → Prop} {a b : α} : (∀ x ∈ s(a, b), P x) ↔ P a ∧ P b := by
442   simp only [mem_iff, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq]
443 
444 lemma pair_eq_pmap {P : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (a b : α) (h : P a) (h' : P b) :
445     s(f a h, f b h') = pmap f s(a, b) (forall_mem_pair.mpr ⟨h, h'⟩) := rfl
446 
447 lemma pmap_pair {P : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (a b : α) (h : ∀ x ∈ s(a, b), P x) :
448     pmap f s(a, b) h = s(f a (h a (mem_mk_left a b)), f b (h b (mem_mk_right a b))) := rfl
449 
450 @[simp]
451 lemma mem_pmap_iff {P : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (z : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ z, P a) (b : β) :
452     b ∈ z.pmap f h ↔ ∃ (a : α) (ha : a ∈ z), b = f a (h a ha) := by
453   obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := z
454   rw [pmap_pair f x y h]
455   aesop
456 
457 lemma pmap_eq_map {P : α → Prop} (f : α → β) (z : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ z, P a) :
458     z.pmap (fun a _ => f a) h = z.map f := by
459   cases z; rfl
460 
461 lemma map_pmap {Q : β → Prop} (f : α → β) (g : ∀ b, Q b → γ) (z : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ b ∈ z.map f, Q b) :
462     (z.map f).pmap g h =
463     z.pmap (fun a ha => g (f a) (h (f a) (mem_map.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩))) (fun _ ha => ha) := by
464   cases z; rfl
465 
466 lemma pmap_map {P : α → Prop} {Q : β → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (g : β → γ)
467     (z : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ z, P a) (h' : ∀ b ∈ z.pmap f h, Q b) :
468     (z.pmap f h).map g = z.pmap (fun a ha => g (f a (h a ha))) (fun _ ha ↦ ha) := by
469   cases z; rfl
470 
471 lemma pmap_pmap {P : α → Prop} {Q : β → Prop} (f : ∀ a, P a → β) (g : ∀ b, Q b → γ)
472     (z : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ z, P a) (h' : ∀ b ∈ z.pmap f h, Q b) :
473     (z.pmap f h).pmap g h' = z.pmap (fun a ha => g (f a (h a ha))
474     (h' _ ((mem_pmap_iff f z h _).mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩))) (fun _ ha ↦ ha) := by
475   cases z; rfl
476 
477 @[simp]
478 lemma pmap_subtype_map_subtypeVal {P : α → Prop} (s : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, P a) :
479     (s.pmap Subtype.mk h).map Subtype.val = s := by
480   cases s; rfl
481 
482 /--
483 "Attach" a proof `P a` that holds for all the elements of `s` to produce a new Sym2 object
484 with the same elements but in the type `{x // P x}`.
485 -/
486 def attachWith {P : α → Prop} (s : Sym2 α) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, P a) : Sym2 {a // P a} :=
487   pmap Subtype.mk s h
488 
489 @[simp]
490 lemma attachWith_map_subtypeVal {s : Sym2 α} {P : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a ∈ s, P a) :
491     (s.attachWith h).map Subtype.val = s := by
492   cases s; rfl

494 /-! ### Diagonal -/
495 
496 variable {z : Sym2 α} {f : α → β}
497 
498 /-- A type `α` is naturally included in the diagonal of `α × α`, and this function gives the image
499 of this diagonal in `Sym2 α`.
500 -/
501 def diag (x : α) : Sym2 α := s(x, x)
502 
503 theorem diag_injective : Function.Injective (Sym2.diag : α → Sym2 α) := fun x y h => by
504   cases Sym2.exact h <;> rfl
505 
506 /-- A predicate for testing whether an element of `Sym2 α` is on the diagonal.
507 -/
508 def IsDiag : Sym2 α → Prop :=
509   lift ⟨Eq, fun _ _ => propext eq_comm⟩
510 
511 @[simp]
512 theorem mk_isDiag_iff {x y : α} : IsDiag s(x, y) ↔ x = y :=
513   Iff.rfl
514 
515 @[deprecated (since := "2026-02-05")] alias isDiag_iff_proj_eq := mk_isDiag_iff
516 
517 protected lemma IsDiag.map : z.IsDiag → (z.map f).IsDiag := Sym2.ind (fun _ _ ↦ congr_arg f) z
518 
519 lemma isDiag_map (hf : Injective f) : (z.map f).IsDiag ↔ z.IsDiag :=
520   Sym2.ind (fun _ _ ↦ hf.eq_iff) z
521 
522 @[simp]
523 theorem diag_isDiag (a : α) : IsDiag (diag a) :=
524   Eq.refl a
525 
526 @[simp, nontriviality]
527 lemma isDiag_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] (z : Sym2 α) : z.IsDiag := z.ind Subsingleton.elim
528 
529 /-- The set of all `Sym2 α` elements on the diagonal. -/
530 def diagSet : Set (Sym2 α) := {z | z.IsDiag}
531 
532 @[simp] lemma mem_diagSet : z ∈ diagSet ↔ z.IsDiag := .rfl
533 
534 @[deprecated mem_diagSet (since := "2025-12-10")]
535 theorem mem_diagSet_iff_isDiag (z : Sym2 α) : z ∈ diagSet ↔ z.IsDiag := .rfl
536 
537 @[simp] lemma range_diag : .range (diag : α → Sym2 α) = diagSet := by
538   ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp [diag, eq_comm]
539 
540 @[deprecated (since := "2025-11-05")] alias ⟨_, IsDiag.mem_range_diag⟩ := mem_diagSet_iff_isDiag
541 
542 @[deprecated range_diag (since := "2025-11-05")]
543 theorem isDiag_iff_mem_range_diag (z : Sym2 α) : IsDiag z ↔ z ∈ Set.range (@diag α) := by simp
544 
545 @[deprecated mem_diagSet (since := "2025-11-05")]
546 theorem mem_diagSet_iff_eq {a b : α} : s(a, b) ∈ diagSet ↔ a = b := by simp
547 
548 theorem diagSet_eq_setOf_isDiag : diagSet = {z : Sym2 α | z.IsDiag} := rfl
549 
550 set_option linter.deprecated false in
551 @[deprecated Set.compl_setOf (since := "2025-12-10")]
552 theorem diagSet_compl_eq_setOf_not_isDiag : diagSetᶜ = {z : Sym2 α | ¬z.IsDiag} :=
553   congrArg _ diagSet_eq_setOf_isDiag
554 
555 theorem diagSet_eq_univ_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] : @diagSet α = Set.univ := by ext; simp
556 
557 instance IsDiag.decidablePred (α : Type u) [DecidableEq α] : DecidablePred (@IsDiag α) :=
558   fun z => z.recOnSubsingleton fun _ _ => decidable_of_iff' _ mk_isDiag_iff
559 
560 instance decidablePred_mem_diagSet (α : Type u) [DecidableEq α] : DecidablePred (· ∈ @diagSet α) :=
561   IsDiag.decidablePred _
562 
563 theorem other_ne {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (hd : ¬IsDiag z) (h : a ∈ z) : Mem.other h ≠ a := by
564   contrapose! hd
565   have h' := Sym2.other_spec h
566   rw [hd] at h'
567   rw [← h']
568   simp

570 section Relations
571 
572 /-! ### Declarations about symmetric relations -/
573 
574 
575 variable {r r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop}
576 
577 /-- Symmetric relations define a set on `Sym2 α` by taking all those pairs
578 of elements that are related.
579 -/
580 def fromRel (sym : Symmetric r) : Set (Sym2 α) :=
581   setOf (lift ⟨r, fun _ _ => propext ⟨(sym ·), (sym ·)⟩⟩)
582 
583 @[simp]
584 theorem fromRel_prop {sym : Symmetric r} {a b : α} : s(a, b) ∈ fromRel sym ↔ r a b :=
585   Iff.rfl
586 
587 @[deprecated (since := "2026-02-05")] alias fromRel_proj_prop := fromRel_prop
588 
589 theorem fromRel_mono_iff (sym₁ : Symmetric r₁) (sym₂ : Symmetric r₂) :
590     fromRel sym₁ ⊆ fromRel sym₂ ↔ r₁ ≤ r₂ :=
591   ⟨fun hle a b ↦ @hle s(a, b), fun hle ↦ Sym2.ind hle⟩
592 
593 @[gcongr]
594 alias ⟨_, fromRel_mono⟩ := fromRel_mono_iff
595 
596 theorem fromRel_bot : fromRel (α := α) (r := ⊥) (fun _ _ ↦ id) = ∅ :=
597   Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem <| Sym2.ind <| by simp
598 
599 @[simp]
600 theorem fromRel_bot_iff {sym : Symmetric r} : fromRel sym = ∅ ↔ r = ⊥ := by
601   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, (· ▸ fromRel_bot)⟩
602   ext x y
603   simpa [h] using fromRel_prop (sym := sym)
604 
605 theorem fromRel_top : fromRel (α := α) (r := ⊤) (fun _ _ ↦ id) = .univ :=
606   Set.eq_univ_of_forall <| Sym2.ind <| by simp
607 
608 @[simp]
609 theorem fromRel_top_iff {sym : Symmetric r} : fromRel sym = .univ ↔ r = ⊤ := by
610   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, (· ▸ fromRel_top)⟩
611   ext x y
612   simpa [h] using fromRel_prop (sym := sym)
613 
614 theorem fromRel_ne : fromRel (fun (_ _ : α) z => z.symm : Symmetric Ne) = {z | ¬IsDiag z} := by
615   ext z; exact z.ind (by simp)
616 
617 lemma diagSet_eq_fromRel_eq : diagSet = fromRel (α := α) eq_equivalence.symmetric := by
618   ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp
619 
620 lemma diagSet_compl_eq_fromRel_ne : diagSetᶜ = fromRel (α := α) (r := Ne) (fun _ _ ↦ Ne.symm) := by
621   ext ⟨a, b⟩; simp
622 
623 @[simp] lemma diagSet_subset_fromRel (hr : Symmetric r) : diagSet ⊆ fromRel hr ↔ Reflexive r := by
624   simp [Set.subset_def, Sym2.forall, Reflexive]
625 
626 @[simp] lemma disjoint_diagSet_fromRel (hr : Symmetric r) :
627     Disjoint diagSet (fromRel hr) ↔ Std.Irrefl r := by
628   refine .trans ?_ ⟨(⟨·⟩), (·.irrefl)⟩
629   simp [Set.disjoint_left, Sym2.forall]
630 
631 @[simp] lemma fromRel_subset_compl_diagSet (hr : Symmetric r) :
632     fromRel hr ⊆ diagSetᶜ ↔ Std.Irrefl r := by simp [Set.subset_compl_iff_disjoint_left]
633 
634 @[deprecated diagSet_subset_fromRel (since := "2025-12-10")]
635 theorem reflexive_iff_diagSet_subset_fromRel (sym : Symmetric r) :
636     Reflexive r ↔ diagSet ⊆ fromRel sym := by simp
637 
638 @[deprecated fromRel_subset_compl_diagSet (since := "2025-12-10")]
639 theorem irreflexive_iff_fromRel_subset_diagSet_compl (sym : Symmetric r) :
640     Std.Irrefl r ↔ fromRel sym ⊆ diagSetᶜ := by simp
641 
642 theorem fromRel_irrefl {sym : Symmetric r} : Std.Irrefl r ↔ ∀ {z}, z ∈ fromRel sym → ¬IsDiag z where
643   mp := by intro ⟨h⟩; apply Sym2.ind; aesop
644   mpr h := ⟨fun _ hr ↦ h (fromRel_prop.mpr hr) rfl⟩
645 
646 @[deprecated (since := "2026-02-12")] alias fromRel_irreflexive := fromRel_irrefl
647 
648 theorem mem_fromRel_irrefl_other_ne {sym : Symmetric r} (irrefl : Std.Irrefl r) {a : α}
649     {z : Sym2 α} (hz : z ∈ fromRel sym) (h : a ∈ z) : Mem.other h ≠ a :=
650   other_ne (fromRel_irrefl.mp irrefl hz) h
651 
652 instance fromRel.decidablePred (sym : Symmetric r) [h : DecidableRel r] :
653     DecidablePred (· ∈ Sym2.fromRel sym) := fun z => z.recOnSubsingleton h
654 
655 lemma fromRel_relationMap {r : α → α → Prop} (hr : Symmetric r) (f : α → β) :
656     fromRel (Relation.map_symmetric hr f) = Sym2.map f '' Sym2.fromRel hr := by
657   ext ⟨a, b⟩
658   simp only [fromRel_prop, Relation.Map, Set.mem_image, Sym2.exists, map_mk, Sym2.eq,
659     rel_iff', Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.swap_prod_mk, and_or_left, exists_or, iff_self_or,
660     forall_exists_index, and_imp]
661   exact fun c d hcd hc hd ↦ ⟨d, c, hr hcd, hd, hc⟩
662 
663 /-- The inverse to `Sym2.fromRel`. Given a set on `Sym2 α`, give a symmetric relation on `α`
664 (see `Sym2.toRel_symmetric`). -/
665 def ToRel (s : Set (Sym2 α)) (x y : α) : Prop :=
666   s(x, y) ∈ s
667 
668 @[simp]
669 theorem toRel_prop (s : Set (Sym2 α)) (x y : α) : ToRel s x y ↔ s(x, y) ∈ s :=
670   Iff.rfl
671 
672 theorem toRel_symmetric (s : Set (Sym2 α)) : Symmetric (ToRel s) := fun x y => by simp [eq_swap]
673 
674 theorem toRel_fromRel (sym : Symmetric r) : ToRel (fromRel sym) = r :=
675   rfl
676 
677 theorem fromRel_toRel (s : Set (Sym2 α)) : fromRel (toRel_symmetric s) = s :=
678   Set.ext fun z => Sym2.ind (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) z
679 
680 theorem toRel_mono_iff (s₁ s₂ : Set (Sym2 α)) : ToRel s₁ ≤ ToRel s₂ ↔ s₁ ⊆ s₂ :=
681   ⟨(Sym2.ind ·), (@· s(·, ·))⟩
682 
683 @[gcongr]
684 alias ⟨_, toRel_mono⟩ := toRel_mono_iff
685 
686 variable (α) in
687 /-- `ToRel` induces an order embedding from `Sym2` sets to relations -/
688 def toRelOrderEmbedding : Set (Sym2 α) ↪o (α → α → Prop) :=
689   .ofMapLEIff ToRel toRel_mono_iff
690 
691 variable (α) in
692 /-- `fromRel`/`ToRel` induce an order isomorphism between symmetric relations and `Sym2` sets -/
693 @[simps]
694 def fromRelOrderIso : { r : α → α → Prop // Symmetric r } ≃o Set (Sym2 α) where
695   toFun r := fromRel r.prop
696   invFun s := ⟨ToRel s, toRel_symmetric s⟩
697   left_inv r := by simp [toRel_fromRel]
698   right_inv s := by simp [fromRel_toRel]
699   map_rel_iff' {r₁ r₂} := by simpa using fromRel_mono_iff ..
700 
701 /-- `fromRel` induces an order embedding from symmetric relations to `Sym2` sets. -/
702 @[deprecated fromRelOrderIso (since := "2026-03-11")]
703 def fromRelOrderEmbedding : { r : α → α → Prop // Symmetric r } ↪o Set (Sym2 α) :=
704   fromRelOrderIso α |>.toOrderEmbedding
705 
706 @[simp]
707 theorem fromRel_eq_fromRel_iff_eq {r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop} (sym₁ : Symmetric r₁)
708     (sym₂ : Symmetric r₂) : fromRel sym₁ = fromRel sym₂ ↔ r₁ = r₂ := by
709   rw [← Subtype.mk.injEq r₁ sym₁ r₂ sym₂, ← fromRelOrderIso α |>.eq_iff_eq]
710   rfl
711 
712 @[deprecated (since := "2026-03-11")] alias fromRel_eq_fromRell_iff_eq := fromRel_eq_fromRel_iff_eq
713 
714 end Relations
715 
716 section ToMultiset
717 
718 /-- Map an unordered pair to an unordered list. -/
719 def toMultiset {α : Type*} (z : Sym2 α) : Multiset α := by
720   refine Sym2.lift ?_ z
721   use (Multiset.ofList [·, ·])
722   simp [List.Perm.swap]
723 
724 /-- Mapping an unordered pair to an unordered list produces a multiset of size `2`. -/
725 lemma card_toMultiset {α : Type*} (z : Sym2 α) : z.toMultiset.card = 2 := by
726   induction z
727   simp [Sym2.toMultiset]
728 
729 /-- The members of an unordered pair are members of the corresponding unordered list. -/
730 @[simp]
731 theorem mem_toMultiset {α : Type*} {x : α} {z : Sym2 α} :
732     x ∈ (z.toMultiset : Multiset α) ↔ x ∈ z := by
733   induction z
734   simp [Sym2.toMultiset]
735 
736 end ToMultiset
737 
738 section ToFinset
739 
740 variable [DecidableEq α]
741 
742 /-- Map an unordered pair to a finite set. -/
743 def toFinset (z : Sym2 α) : Finset α := (z.toMultiset : Multiset α).toFinset
744 
745 /-- The members of an unordered pair are members of the corresponding finite set. -/
746 @[simp]
747 theorem mem_toFinset {x : α} {z : Sym2 α} : x ∈ z.toFinset ↔ x ∈ z := by
748   rw [← Sym2.mem_toMultiset, Sym2.toFinset, Multiset.mem_toFinset]
749 
750 @[simp]
751 theorem toFinset_ne_empty (z : Sym2 α) : z.toFinset ≠ ∅ := by
752   exact Finset.ne_empty_of_mem (Sym2.mem_toFinset.mpr (Sym2.out_fst_mem _))
753 
754 lemma toFinset_mk_eq {x y : α} : s(x, y).toFinset = {x, y} := by
755   ext; simp [← Sym2.mem_toFinset, ← Sym2.mem_iff]
756 
757 /-- Mapping an unordered pair on the diagonal to a finite set produces a finset of size `1`. -/
758 theorem card_toFinset_of_isDiag (z : Sym2 α) (h : z.IsDiag) : #(z : Sym2 α).toFinset = 1 := by
759   induction z
760   rw [Sym2.mk_isDiag_iff] at h
761   simp [Sym2.toFinset_mk_eq, h]
762 
763 /-- Mapping an unordered pair off the diagonal to a finite set produces a finset of size `2`. -/
764 theorem card_toFinset_of_not_isDiag (z : Sym2 α) (h : ¬z.IsDiag) : #(z : Sym2 α).toFinset = 2 := by
765   induction z
766   rw [Sym2.mk_isDiag_iff] at h
767   simp [Sym2.toFinset_mk_eq, h]
768 
769 /-- Mapping an unordered pair to a finite set produces a finset of size `1` if the pair is on the
770 diagonal, else of size `2` if the pair is off the diagonal. -/
771 theorem card_toFinset (z : Sym2 α) : #(z : Sym2 α).toFinset = if z.IsDiag then 1 else 2 := by
772   by_cases h : z.IsDiag
773   · simp [card_toFinset_of_isDiag z h, h]
774   · simp [card_toFinset_of_not_isDiag z h, h]
775 
776 end ToFinset
777 
778 section SymEquiv
779 
780 /-! ### Equivalence to the second symmetric power -/
781 
782 
783 attribute [local instance] List.Vector.Perm.isSetoid
784 
785 set_option backward.privateInPublic true in
786 set_option backward.privateInPublic.warn false in
787 private def fromVector : List.Vector α 2 → α × α
788   | ⟨[a, b], _⟩ => (a, b)
789 
790 private theorem perm_card_two_iff {a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : α} :
791     [a₁, b₁].Perm [a₂, b₂] ↔ a₁ = a₂ ∧ b₁ = b₂ ∨ a₁ = b₂ ∧ b₁ = a₂ :=
792   { mp := by
793       simp only [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, ← Multiset.cons_coe, Multiset.coe_nil, Multiset.cons_zero,
794         Multiset.cons_eq_cons, Multiset.singleton_inj, ne_eq, Multiset.singleton_eq_cons_iff,
795         exists_eq_right_right, and_true]
796       tauto
797     mpr := fun
798         | .inl ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | .inr ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => by
799           rw [h₁, h₂]
800           first | done | constructor }
801 
802 set_option backward.privateInPublic true in
803 set_option backward.privateInPublic.warn false in
804 /-- The symmetric square is equivalent to length-2 vectors up to permutations. -/
805 def sym2EquivSym' : Equiv (Sym2 α) (Sym' α 2) where
806   toFun :=
807     Quot.map (fun x : α × α => ⟨[x.1, x.2], rfl⟩)
808       (by
809         rintro _ _ ⟨_⟩
810         · constructor; apply List.Perm.refl
811         apply List.Perm.swap'
812         rfl)
813   invFun :=
814     Quot.map fromVector
815       (by
816         rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ h
817         rcases x with - | ⟨_, x⟩; · simp at hx
818         rcases x with - | ⟨_, x⟩; · simp at hx
819         rcases x with - | ⟨_, x⟩; swap
820         · exfalso
821           simp at hx
822         rcases y with - | ⟨_, y⟩; · simp at hy
823         rcases y with - | ⟨_, y⟩; · simp at hy
824         rcases y with - | ⟨_, y⟩; swap
825         · exfalso
826           simp at hy
827         rcases perm_card_two_iff.mp h with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
828         · constructor
829         apply Sym2.Rel.swap)
830   left_inv := by apply Sym2.ind; aesop (add norm unfold [Sym2.fromVector])
831   right_inv x := by
832     refine x.recOnSubsingleton fun x => ?_
833     obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
834     obtain - | ⟨-, x⟩ := x
835     · simp at hx
836     rcases x with - | ⟨_, x⟩
837     · simp at hx
838     rcases x with - | ⟨_, x⟩
839     swap
840     · exfalso
841       simp at hx
842     rfl
843 
844 /-- The symmetric square is equivalent to the second symmetric power. -/
845 def equivSym (α : Type*) : Sym2 α ≃ Sym α 2 :=
846   Equiv.trans sym2EquivSym' symEquivSym'.symm
847 
848 /-- The symmetric square is equivalent to multisets of cardinality
849 two. (This is currently a synonym for `equivSym`, but it's provided
850 in case the definition for `Sym` changes.) -/
851 def equivMultiset (α : Type*) : Sym2 α ≃ { s : Multiset α // Multiset.card s = 2 } :=
852   equivSym α
853 
854 end SymEquiv
855 
856 section Decidable
857 
858 /-- Given `[DecidableEq α]` and `[Fintype α]`, the following instance gives `Fintype (Sym2 α)`.
859 -/
860 instance instDecidableRel [DecidableEq α] : DecidableRel (Rel α) :=
861   fun _ _ => decidable_of_iff' _ rel_iff
862 
863 section
864 attribute [local instance] Sym2.Rel.setoid
865 
866 instance instDecidableRel' [DecidableEq α] : DecidableRel (HasEquiv.Equiv (α := α × α)) :=
867   instDecidableRel
868 
869 end
870 
871 instance [DecidableEq α] : DecidableEq (Sym2 α) :=
872   inferInstanceAs <| DecidableEq (Quotient (Sym2.Rel.setoid α))
873 
874 /-! ### The other element of an element of the symmetric square -/
875 
876 /-- Get the other element of the unordered pair using the decidable equality.
877 This is the computable version of `Mem.other`. -/
878 @[aesop norm unfold (rule_sets := [Sym2])]
879 def Mem.other' [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : α :=
880   Sym2.rec (fun b c _ => if a = b then c else b) (by
881     clear h z
882     intro b c d e h
883     ext hy
884     have {f g h} : @Eq.ndrec (Sym2 α) s(b, c)
885       (fun x => a ∈ x → α) (fun _ => if a = b then c else b) f g h =
886         if a = b then c else b := by subst g; rfl
887     aesop)
888     z h
889 
890 @[simp]
891 theorem other_spec' [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : s(a, Mem.other' h) = z := by
892   induction z
893   aesop (add norm unfold [Sym2.rec, Quot.rec]) (rule_sets := [Sym2])
894 
895 @[simp]
896 theorem other_eq_other' [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) :
897     Mem.other h = Mem.other' h := by rw [← congr_right, other_spec' h, other_spec]
898 
899 theorem other_mem' [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (h : a ∈ z) : Mem.other' h ∈ z := by
900   rw [← other_eq_other']
901   exact other_mem h
902 
903 theorem other_invol' [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (ha : a ∈ z) (hb : Mem.other' ha ∈ z) :
904     Mem.other' hb = a := by
905   induction z
906   aesop (rule_sets := [Sym2]) (add norm unfold [Sym2.rec, Quot.rec])
907 
908 theorem other_invol {a : α} {z : Sym2 α} (ha : a ∈ z) (hb : Mem.other ha ∈ z) :
909     Mem.other hb = a := by
910   classical
911     rw [other_eq_other'] at hb ⊢
912     convert other_invol' ha hb using 2
913     apply other_eq_other'
914 
915 theorem filter_image_mk_isDiag [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) :
916     {x ∈ (s ×ˢ s).image Sym2.mk.uncurry | x.IsDiag} = s.diag.image Sym2.mk.uncurry := by aesop
917 
918 theorem filter_image_mk_not_isDiag [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) :
919     {x ∈ (s ×ˢ s).image Sym2.mk.uncurry | ¬x.IsDiag} = s.offDiag.image Sym2.mk.uncurry := by aesop
920 
921 end Decidable
922 
923 instance [Subsingleton α] : Subsingleton (Sym2 α) :=
924   (equivSym α).injective.subsingleton
925 
926 instance [Unique α] : Unique (Sym2 α) :=
927   Unique.mk' _
928 
929 instance [IsEmpty α] : IsEmpty (Sym2 α) :=
930   (equivSym α).isEmpty
931 
932 instance [Nontrivial α] : Nontrivial (Sym2 α) :=
933   diag_injective.nontrivial
934 
935 -- TODO: use a sort order if available, https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib/issues/18166
936 unsafe instance [Repr α] : Repr (Sym2 α) where
937   reprPrec s _ := f!"s({repr s.unquot.1}, {repr s.unquot.2})"
938 
939 lemma lift_smul_lift {α R N} [SMul R N] (f : { f : α → α → R // ∀ a₁ a₂, f a₁ a₂ = f a₂ a₁ })
940     (g : { g : α → α → N // ∀ a₁ a₂, g a₁ a₂ = g a₂ a₁ }) :
941     lift f • lift g = lift ⟨f.val • g.val, fun _ _ => by
942       rw [Pi.smul_apply', Pi.smul_apply', Pi.smul_apply', Pi.smul_apply', f.prop, g.prop]⟩ := by
943   ext ⟨i, j⟩
944   simp_all only [Pi.smul_apply', lift_mk]
945 
946 /--
947 Multiplication as a function from `Sym2`.
948 -/
949 @[to_additive /-- Addition as a function from `Sym2`. -/]
950 def mul {M} [CommMagma M] : Sym2 M → M := lift ⟨(· * ·), mul_comm⟩
951 
952 @[to_additive (attr := simp)]
953 lemma mul_mk {M} [CommMagma M] (a b : M) : mul s(a, b) = a * b := rfl
954 
955 end Sym2
956 
957 namespace Set
958 
959 open Sym2
960 
961 variable {s : Set α}
962 
963 /--
964 For a set `s : Set α`, `s.sym2` is the set of all unordered pairs of elements from `s`.
965 -/
966 def sym2 (s : Set α) : Set (Sym2 α) := fromRel (r := fun x y ↦ x ∈ s ∧ y ∈ s) (fun _ _ => .symm)
967 
968 @[simp] lemma mk_mem_sym2_iff {x y : α} : s(x, y) ∈ s.sym2 ↔ x ∈ s ∧ y ∈ s := Iff.rfl
969 
970 @[deprecated (since := "2026-02-05")] alias mk'_mem_sym2_iff := mk_mem_sym2_iff
971 
972 lemma mem_sym2_iff_subset {z : Sym2 α} : z ∈ s.sym2 ↔ (z : Set α) ⊆ s := by
973   induction z using Sym2.inductionOn
974   simp [pair_subset_iff]
975 
976 lemma sym2_eq_mk_image : s.sym2 = (Sym2.mk.uncurry) '' s ×ˢ s := by ext ⟨x, y⟩; aesop
977 
978 @[simp] lemma mk_preimage_sym2 : (Sym2.mk.uncurry) ⁻¹' s.sym2 = s ×ˢ s := rfl
979 
980 @[simp] lemma sym2_empty : (∅ : Set α).sym2 = ∅ := by ext ⟨x, y⟩; simp
981 @[simp] lemma sym2_univ : (Set.univ : Set α).sym2 = Set.univ := by ext ⟨x, y⟩; simp
982 
983 @[simp] lemma sym2_singleton (a : α) : ({a} : Set α).sym2 = {s(a, a)} := by ext ⟨x, y⟩; simp
984 lemma sym2_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) :
985     (insert a s).sym2 = (fun b ↦ s(a, b)) '' insert a s ∪ s.sym2 := by
986   ext ⟨x, y⟩; aesop
987 
988 lemma sym2_preimage {f : α → β} {s : Set β} : (f ⁻¹' s).sym2 = Sym2.map f ⁻¹' s.sym2 := by
989   ext ⟨x, y⟩
990   simp
991 
992 lemma sym2_image {f : α → β} {s : Set α} : (f '' s).sym2 = Sym2.map f '' s.sym2 := by
993   simp_rw [sym2_eq_mk_image, prod_image_image_eq, image_image, uncurry, Sym2.map_mk]
994 
995 lemma sym2_inter (s t : Set α) : (s ∩ t).sym2 = s.sym2 ∩ t.sym2 :=
996   preimage_injective.mpr Sym2.mk_surjective <| Set.prod_inter_prod.symm
997 
998 lemma sym2_iInter {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Set α) : (⋂ i, f i).sym2 = ⋂ i, (f i).sym2 := by
999   ext ⟨x, y⟩; simp [forall_and]
1000 
1001 end Set
